title: USP Webhook Events
description: Webhook payloads for USP booking, catalog, and waitlist lifecycle notifications. Businesses POST these to the platform webhook_url; payloads MUST be signed per Section 10.1.1.

BookingEvent.title: BookingEvent
BookingEvent.description: Booking lifecycle webhook payload (REST body or MCP usp_webhook params).

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. Platforms MUST process deliveries idempotently using event_id.

booking_id.description: The booking this event relates to.

order_id.description: UCP order ID when the booking was created via UCP-Native Mode checkout. SHOULD be included for correlation.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time when the event occurred.

data.description: Full booking object. SHOULD be included except as noted in Sections 5.4.1 and 5.5.3.

service_id.description: The service this event relates to.

subscription_id.description: The feed subscription that triggered this notification.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time when the event occurred.

data.description: Full service object for created and updated events.

WaitlistEvent.title: WaitlistEvent
WaitlistEvent.description: Waitlist lifecycle webhook payload (REST body or MCP usp_webhook params when the dev.usp-protocol.services.waitlist capability is in use).

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. Platforms MUST process deliveries idempotently using event_id.

entry_id.description: The waitlist entry this event relates to.

service_id.description: The service the waitlist entry is for.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time when the event occurred.

data.description: Full waitlist entry object. SHOULD be included except as noted in Section 11.1.5.
